name: io.github.tonyyang0504/woocommerce-mcp
description: WooCommerce (ecommerce channels): me, create_listing, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, li

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WooCommerce REST API consumer key (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API > Add key, Read/Write) sent as the HTTP Basic username over HTTPS.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The consumer secret shown once when the key is created; sent as the HTTP Basic password.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WOOCOMMERCE_STORE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host (and any path prefix) of the merchant's WooCommerce store without scheme, e.g. shop.example.com or example.com/shop; every call goes to https://<store_host>/wp-json/wc/v3/... (HTTPS only: Basic auth with the consumer key/secret is documented for HTTPS; plain-HTTP stores need OAuth 1.0a, not supported).
